in_sanskrit.name: Bhamita
in_sanskrit.meaning: goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhaga (wealth, fortune) + Mita (giver, bestower) => Goddess who bestows wealth of knowledge

in_hindi.name: बहमिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhaga (wealth, fortune) + Mita (giver) => Goddess who bestows wealth of knowledge

in_tamil.name: பக்கமிடா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Pakkam (one who is present) + Idā (one who goes) + A (mother) => Goddess who is present to guide and lead the path of knowledge

in_telugu.name: భహమిటా
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bhaga (wealth, fortune) + Mita (giver) => Goddess who bestows wealth of knowledge

in_marathi.name: Bhamita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhamita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bham’, meaning mountain. ‘Bhamita’ translates to mountain-born or mountain-dweller.

in_bengali.name: Bhamita
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhamita একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bham’, meaning mountain. ‘Bhamita’ translates to mountain-born or mountain-dweller.
